description.en: Adds a Skills page to the sidebar with two tabs: Installed lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session and uninstalls each one the right way (through npx skills, or by deleting a manually installed directory); Saved repos keeps a personal list of npx skills sources (owner/repo, GitHub links, package names), opens a repo from its title, copies the install command, and expands each GitHub repository into a cached skills tree.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏新增「Skills」页面，顶部两个 Tab：已安装列出对所有会话生效的全局 skills，并按来源选择正确的卸载方式（交给 npx skills，或直接删除手工安装的目录）；收藏仓库用来记下常用的 npx skills 来源（owner/repo、GitHub 链接、包名），点标题打开仓库、复制安装命令，GitHub 仓库还能展开成带缓存的 skills 树。
